name: Z.A.T.O. // I Love the World and Everything In It
source:
[b]USSR, 1986.[/b] When Ira Grachevskaya goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, not a soul seems to be concerned – except for the quiet outcast Asya Shubina, that is. Uncover the mystery behind Ira’s disappearance, transmit your radio signal to the universe and learn why a bird flies past the window.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4122860/]Steam[/url]]
